title: The 4-step Perplexity workflow consultants charge for
caption: How to get consultant-grade research out of Perplexity in 20 minutes. Save this.

slides.title: Define the decision first
slides.body: Don't search a topic — search a decision. "I need to decide X. What evidence would change my mind either way?" Research without a decision is just scrolling.

slides.title: Go narrow, then wide
slides.body: Start with the most specific question you have. Then zoom out: "What is the obvious answer here, and why might it be wrong?" Narrow surfaces facts; wide surfaces blind spots.

slides.title: Demand the sources
slides.body: "For each claim, give the primary source and its date. Flag anything older than 18 months or from a vendor selling the thing." Recency and incentive kill bad research.

slides.title: Run the contrarian pass
slides.body: "Argue the strongest case AGAINST the conclusion you just gave me. What would an expert who disagrees say?" If it survives this, it's usable.

slides.title: Compress to a brief
slides.body: "Summarize as: the answer, the 3 reasons, the 1 risk, the source I'd cite if challenged." That's the deliverable a consultant bills $2k for.

slides.quote: Most people use AI search to confirm. The edge is using it to disconfirm.
